_comment: Extra libADLMIDI render passes over the embedded banks (plan §6 variants table).
Bank numbers refer to catalog/adl_banks.json (adlmidiplay --list-banks order, libADLMIDI 1.6.2).
variants.py turns each entry into adl-b{NN}-{suffix} variants; edit here, never in variants.json.

passes.rationale: AdLib / Sound Blaster-era 2-op banks (AIL default, HMI, DMX, SB IBK, Apogee TMB, Fat Man 2-op, MS-AdLib Win3.x) heard as on an OPL2 card: DOSBox OPL2 core, 9 mono channels, no 4-op, no stereo - the way the original DOS games sounded. 4-op banks, NON-GM and MISS-INS banks are left out (bank 57, Simon the Sorcerer, is MT-32-style but in the plan's list and kept).

Flagship full-GM banks through ESFMu (ESS ESFM in OPL3-compatible mode: different envelope, feedback and waveform behaviour from a real YMF262). Per plan §6 a bank's ESFM pass is dropped at M2a if a null-test against the Nuked render correlates > 0.99.

The same ten flagship banks through Nuked CQM (Compaq/Yamaha 'CQM' OPL3 clone used in late-90s OEM chips: audibly different operator math). Flagships = most-played GM banks: AIL default, DMX v2 and default, Fat Man Win9x, Duke3D TMB, GMOPL mod, O'Connell, Apogee default, DMXOPL3, MS-AdLib.
